A test drives github.oracle_reviews through the real paging call (a fake `gh api` returning more than one page) and asserts every review is returned
A test with more than 5 out-of-scope defects shows exactly 5 listed and the rest summarised
A test forces a long status description and asserts it is cut to 140 characters
The misnamed runner test is renamed or made to omit a status
Gap 6 is either covered or its omission is recorded with the reason
Each new test fails under a one-off mutation of its rule; the PR body lists them
Merged through the normal PR flow with an oracle success review of the merged head
context: Found in the completion audit of the oracle protocol on 2026-10-09. The marker size boundary is tracked separately in oracle-marker-patch-map-file-limit-20261009.
description:
A behaviour-by-behaviour audit of the oracle protocol tests on develop e7eb5ce7e found every named behaviour implemented and most covered, with these gaps:
1. A malformed or repeated marker makes the plan return `hold` (tested), but the finalize step that turns `hold` into a pending status (`cli.command_finalize`) is not: test_attempts.py::test_cli_finalize_fixed_decisions covers only `success` and `fork`.
2. test_cli_plan.py::test_more_than_a_hundred_reviews_are_all_read replaces github.oracle_reviews with a fake that returns 151 reviews, so nothing tests that the real call pages (`get_paginated`, `--paginate --slurp` in github.py).
3. The cap of 5 on defects listed as "not counted" (protocol.NOT_COUNTED_LIMIT) is not tested; the only test uses one such defect.
4. No test forces a status description over 140 characters through report._clip.
5. test_runner.py::test_a_follow_up_missing_a_prior_status_is_recorded_for_the_judge passes a status through and never omits one; its name overstates it (the real coverage is test_rounds.py::test_a_prior_defect_with_no_status_stays_open).
6. The #2769 replay uses synthetic prior statuses and checks the planner and judge, not the posted review bodies.

The marker size boundary is tracked separately in oracle-marker-patch-map-file-limit-20261009.

Guardrails.
- Tests only: no behaviour change in _project/scripts/. If a new test exposes a real defect, stop, file it as its own item, and mark the test `xfail(strict=True)` with the item id only if the owner agrees.
- Every new test must be able to fail: check each with a one-off mutation of the rule it covers and list the mutations in the PR body. No test may assert only that code runs.
- Worktree via `make worktree-create` and `make agent-write-preflight`; identity Joe Harris <joeharris76@gmail.com>; explicit staging; no comments or docstrings; `make comment-policy-check`.
- May ship in one PR with oracle-oversize-pr-pending-loop-20261009, oracle-post-guard-reread-retry-20261009 and oracle-marker-patch-map-file-limit-20261009.

Decision gate. Gap 6 (replay of posted bodies) is optional: do it only if it fits without a new fixture format; otherwise record in this item why it was left.
